content:
The works below are those cited in the articles and listed in the bibliography of the book. Scripture is quoted in the articles in the Greek of the SBL edition with the King James Version beneath it; the book itself quotes Malay and Indonesian translations. Reports, manuscripts and web sources appear at the end.

Scripture

  • The Qurʾān. English renderings in the article on the Qurʾān as witness follow The Qurʾan: English Meanings, Saheeh International. Jeddah: Al-Muntada Al-Islami, 2004.
  • The Hebrew Bible and the New Testament. Quoted in the King James Version; the book quotes the Alkitab Berita Baik (Bible Society of Malaysia, 1996), the Alkitab Versi Borneo (LAB Network, 2015), the Alkitab (Lembaga Alkitab Indonesia, 2000) and the Kitab Suci Indonesian Modern Bible (Yayasan Anugerah Kebenaran Indonesia, 2015).
  • Nestle-Aland, Novum Testamentum Graece, 28th edition.
  • Michael W. Holmes (ed.), The Greek New Testament: SBL Edition. Atlanta: Society of Biblical Literature; Bellingham: Logos Bible Software, 2010. The Greek text quoted with every New Testament passage on this site.
  • Book of Judith.

Hadith and classical Islamic sources

  • Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī; Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim; Musnad Aḥmad; Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī; al-Adab al-Mufrad; al-Sunan al-Kubrā.

  • ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm al-Qummī, Tafsīr al-Qummī, ed. Ṭayyib al-Mūsawī al-Jazāʾirī, vol. 1. Beirut: Dār al-Walāʾ li-Ṣināʿat al-Nashr, 2018.

  • Muḥammad al-Qaysī, Kitāb Miftāḥ al-Dīn wa-l-Mujādalah bayna al-Naṣārā wa-l-Muslimīn, MS 1557, National Library of Algeria.

Jewish sources

  • Babylonian Talmud: Berakhot, Yoma, Yevamoth, Kethuboth, Nedarim, Sanhedrin, Pesachim, Ḥagigah.
  • Mishnah Parah.
  • Avot de-Rabbi Natan.
  • Midrash Rabbah: Shemot Rabbah, Bamidbar Rabbah.
  • Midrash Tehillim.
